## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 scripts/check.py` passes
- [ ] A changed rule in a template has its doc page (`docs/`) changed too
- [ ] Changed a skill, form or template: I built a test brain as someone who sells and wants a brief, and as someone who doesn't, and read what was built
- [ ] Changed the upgrade: I upgraded a copy of an older brain, and its own rules stayed word for word
- [ ] Every `data-name` I added or renamed is read by `SKILL.md`, and nothing reads a name that's gone
- [ ] Folder names, file names, links to files and info block words are still in English
- [ ] Anything a person sees says "your agent", not a product name
- [ ] Plain words, and no em dashes
- [ ] The agent still asks before it creates, moves, renames or deletes notes
- [ ] No real notes, names or private details anywhere in the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line
- [ ] The NOTICE credit is unchanged
